## Highlights

- Adds the accumulated renderer fixes and bounded engine dependency prepared
  since 0.1.0.
- Tests development against released `carve-lang` 0.1.2 while retaining the
  verified `>= 0.1.1, < 0.2.0` consumer range.
- Publishes through RubyGems trusted publishing; the release gate builds,
  inspects, installs, loads, and renders through the exact gem first.

HexaPDF remains dual-licensed AGPL-3.0/commercial; consult its licensing terms
for closed-source use.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/markup-carve/carve-hexapdf/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
